records.issue_text: [Low/bug] When no category is selected, the server stores the uncategorized category but the client calls `findById(null)`, displaying a blank category until reload
records.rationale: The server's save_host assigns `host.category_id = SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id if host.category_id.blank?`, but the component's save action does `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId'))))` where categoryId was never updated from the server response and remains null when nothing was selected, so findById(null) yields no category and the row displays blank until reload. The described mechanism is consistent with the diff.
